payload.title: AI-written marketing briefs face new industry review rules
payload.text: Industry groups are drafting review rules for AI-generated marketing briefs after several campaigns published claims without sources. The proposed guidelines ask teams to keep citation logs and require editorial sign-off before paid media launches. Experts say the rules aim to slow reckless automation without banning useful drafting tools.
